# Nithron pixel icons (vendored)

`index.js` and `index.d.ts` are the generated files of `@nithron/icons` 0.1.0, from the nithron-site repository (packages/icons), copied unchanged. Every icon is ink on a 16 by 16 grid, one path, shown at 16 or 32 px only. Never edit them. To update, copy the new files over these. Niro uses them only through `src/components/Icon.tsx`.

The package is under the Nithron Community License v1.0, the same licence text as this repository's `LICENSE` (the two files are byte-identical), so no separate licence file is kept here.
